commands.skyabyss_play.help.0: §bPlaytest commands (/skyabyss play) §7- permission 2. The optional last [targets] defaults to yourself
commands.skyabyss_play.help.1: §fplay status [targets] §7- chapter, main quest stages and stilled titans
commands.skyabyss_play.help.2: §fplay chapter <0-5> [stage] §7- set up a chapter (0 fresh / 1 whale / 2 tide / 3 storm / 4 ember / 5 abyss)
commands.skyabyss_play.help.3: §fplay goto <place> [targets] §7- go to a place (overworld, whale/tide/storm/ember back entry, <titan>-<spot>, abyss, abyss-<mark>, abyss-depth-<n>)
commands.skyabyss_play.help.4: §fplay kit <iron|whale|tide|storm|ember> [targets] §7- gear set (armor, weapons, arrows, healing, health target)
commands.skyabyss_play.help.5: §fplay boss <whale|tide|storm|ember|raiju|smith|warden|nightmare> [tier 0-4] §7- go to the boss and start it
commands.skyabyss_play.help.6: §fplay quest <id> [stage|done|reset] §7- set the stage / finish it / back to the first stage
commands.skyabyss_play.help.7: §fplay lore unlock-all|reset [targets] §7- open all lore / clear it
commands.skyabyss_play.help.9: §fplay peaceful on|off §7- switch the world difficulty to peaceful or normal
commands.skyabyss_play.help.10: §fplay heal|feed [targets] §7and §fplay god on|off [targets] §7- heal, fill food, invulnerable
commands.skyabyss_play.help.11: §fplay reset me [targets] §7- back to a fresh state (chapter, quests, stilled titans, invulnerability)
commands.skyabyss_play.bad_stage: That stage is not in this quest: %s
commands.skyabyss_play.place_missing: That place is not built yet (skipped): %s
